name: Alex Rivera
summary: Fictional example. Senior Backend Engineer at Acme Payments, leading a team of 4 engineers that builds integrations with card networks and bank APIs on AWS. Runs 1:1s and performance reviews with the manager, owns delivery against team OKRs and stays hands-on in design and code review. Median cycle time 3.2 days; release lead time cut from 21 days to 6.

experience.detail_left: Promoted from Senior Engineer L2 to L3
bullets: Lead a team of 4 engineers (since Mar 2023); onboarded all four and run their 1:1s and performance reviews with the manager.
Delivered ~180 tickets a quarter at a 3.2-day median cycle time (90% estimated, 95% with acceptance criteria), tracked in Jira against team OKRs.
Cut release lead time from 21 days to 6 by automating the deploy pipeline (GitHub Actions, Terraform).
Cut production incidents from 3 a month to 0 recurring with contract tests, a stricter Definition of Done and Datadog alerts on every provider call.
Cut provider timeouts by 40% with retries, backoff and a circuit breaker on the three busiest integrations.
Built the provider-integration service on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB.
Added retries with backoff on the first three integrations.
Built order and inventory APIs in Python and PostgreSQL.

skills.label: Technologies:
skills.value: AWS (Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, PostgreSQL
